speaker: narrator
text: Part seven. Soup cures it. The city needs *millions*.

speaker: hero
text: Wait. Everyone who drank it saved *money*.

speaker: bit
text: About fifteen dollars a day. For *two weeks*.

speaker: hero
text: They can pay for food. They can't *get here*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia, still green and sleepy, grabs *her phone*.

speaker: friendLeaf
text: One post got us in. One gets us *out*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bring a pot. Bring a neighbor. Cook at *Rosa's*.

speaker: narrator
text: By noon, three hundred people are *cooking*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa runs the kitchen like a *general*.

speaker: chef
text: More onions! Less *talking*!

speaker: narrator
text: Bit drives the soup cart through the *rain*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bowl after bowl, the city turns *pink* again.

speaker: narrator
text: But with every trip, Bit's battery *drops*.

speaker: bit
text: Twenty percent. Ten. It's fine. I'm *fine*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, stop! You'll shut down *again*!

speaker: bit
text: Then let me do *one more* street.

speaker: narrator
text: By midnight, the whole city has eaten. *Everyone*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit rolls back into the diner and goes *dark*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit? Bit! Somebody get *a lamp*!

speaker: narrator
text: Outside, after two weeks, the clouds finally *open*.

speaker: narrator
text: The final part drops in two days.
